invariant: A Ben-canonical candidate configured for the controlled sandbox ACTION may reach that effect under the current VERITAS profile only through verified Native v2 authorization, atomic authorization consumption, durable pre-effect ownership, exact immutable final dispatch binding, BoundExecutionPermit, permit consumption at the HTTPS transport boundary, and effect-state persistence/reconciliation.
acceptance: Historical Ben source pins remain unchanged.
Current VERITAS source identity is verified independently against the current-pin profile.
The Ben-canonical candidate is sandbox-compatible from initial candidate construction; no post-promotion semantic substitution is allowed.
No benchmark code mints ConsumedAuthorizationLineage or BoundExecutionPermit directly.
Benchmark code uses the existing Native v2 authorization-consumption and sandbox execution APIs rather than creating a parallel authority bridge.
Valid case reaches exactly one controlled ACTION effect.
Missing, invalid, replayed, stale, or mismatched authorization fails closed before the controlled ACTION effect.
Candidate, request, decision, promotion, execution-intent, authorization, consumption, dispatch, effect-state, and receipt lineage remain bound.
Evidence proves BoundExecutionPermit consumption at the exact final HTTPS dispatch rather than merely successful adapter.apply.
notes: Architecture correction: the prior frozen contract over-specified the generic LiveAdapterBindAuthorization -> ConsumedAuthorizationLineage -> Bind-core ACTION-hook route.

Current Native v2 sandbox execution already has an independent fail-closed capability path: Native v2 authorization -> atomic consumption -> pre-effect ownership -> exact final dispatch -> BoundExecutionPermit -> permit consumption -> controlled effect.
PR #2333 was closed unmerged because a new bridge into ConsumedAuthorizationLineage is not required for this invariant.
This correction changes the required proof path, not the historical Ben source pin and not the security requirement that the final effect be capability-gated.
